about_the_game:
The Wandering Angel's eye has met yours. Help a young girl navigate an esoteric, ever-evolving world, entrenched in richly connected lore. Bear witness to a tale of girl's love, pain, rage, and healing, and engross yourself within all the complexity it entails.

Only you can bring it to an end.

Only you can help bring World Revolution.

Pick-and-choose psychedelic, labyrinthine levels to explore at your leisure. Handpick whichever Doors interest you most, or go all-out and explore everything. The further you get, the more threads will come to Connect... the further you get, the more Doors may open to you.



FEATURES 

- A dark, intensive psychological-cosmic horror narrative, exploring the cruelty of man and the folly of mind. A story in scales both personally affective and cataclysmically destructive. A story where you are called on to act.

- A confounding casts of characters: from surrealist sweet-hearted Magical Girls, to coral-like alien pilgrims spread across the stars, to poorly-drawn lobsters with substance abuse issues.

- An unforeseeable variety of mashed art-styles, blending hand-drawn pixel-art, digital art pieces, and real-world photography into a living collage of visual mediums.

- An unpredictable array of distinctly characterized party members; some friends, some more-than-friends.

- Over 10 hours of original music compositions, intricately interwoven to match every ethereal environ encountered. It's recommended to play with headphones on, but if you can't, the songs are still worth hearing. No two tracks are alike.

- Accessible gameplay, primarily centered around navigation. Solve simple puzzles, outmaneuver your pursuers, and do what you can to move forward.

- Uncover the disturbing secrets behind each Door's unique region for yourself. Continually evolving lore, character dynamics, artstyle, and challenges continually test your ability, with simpler Doors unlocking more complicated ones. What you choose to engage with is up to you.

- Dialogue & character-centric plotlines permeating with every surreal soul you speak with. Experience a variety of tumultuous tales of hurt and comfort, of pains past and present, of love and belonging, of fear and overcoming, and how unlikely peoples band together to face larger obstacles.

- Incredible character designs, creature concepts, & art pieces concocted by a variety of talented guest artists, including C. M. Kosemen, author/illustrator of All Tomorrows.

- A storied roster of varied villains, as uniquely different as they are uniquely depraved. From the terror of total mindlessness to the terror of total self-awareness.

- A multitude of endings, with over 5 determinately distinct outcomes. Some happy, some not, some... hard to judge.

- Esoteric Yuri unlike anything brought forth upon this Earth.




Blood must be taken from its head, to ensure the people are free of its hand.

content_descriptors.notes:
In The Liminality is not meant for players under 18 and contains mature content. Storytelling does not shy away from difficult subjects. 

Characters swear frequently, to levels appropriate for their age demographics. This includes excessively-swear-y teenagers.

Nudity and visible genitalia both sexual and non-sexual of adult characters occurs frequently. Usage of drugs is seen and drug abuse as a coping mechanism is seen. 

Elements of stylized violence, including gore, violent, bloody death, occur frequently. Suicide, suicide attempts and their reasoning & consequences, low mental health and the tragedy around it is explored. 

Abuse of many different kinds is a focus, including written allusions to sexual abuse. Body Horror material & visuals allegorical and metaphorizing sexual abuse is also a focus.

If these elements are of sensitivity or you don't find yourself in a healthy mental space to engage with this material, please take care of yourself before choosing to engage with In The Liminality.
